_comment: Advisories accepted for DEV tooling only (the production audit has no exceptions). Each needs a reason and an expiry; after the expiry CI fails again so it is looked at.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in picomatch <=4.0.7, reached only through dev tools (vite, vitest, typescript-eslint, @nestjs/cli) that match our own globs. No fixed release exists on 2026-11-18; npm's suggested fix is a downgrade.
